name: ASPR AI
description: ASPR connects Claude to your sales workspace. Ask about upcoming meetings and get AI-generated prep and pre-meeting podcasts; review past meetings with recaps, transcripts, MEDDPICC extraction, sentiment analysis, and suggested follow-up emails; explore your pipeline with deals, accounts, leads, deal insights, and team members; and improve with per-meeting coaching tips, speech metrics, narrative reviews, and development plans. Search across deals, accounts, and meetings by keyword, and trigger generation of documents, deal insights, meeting prep, and podcasts directly from chat. All reads are safe and scoped to your ASPR account; admins can optionally query company-wide data.

_published_faq.name: How do I add ASPR AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add ASPR AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://production-api.aspr.ai/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the ASPR AI MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: ASPR AI lists 38 MCP tools, including accounts_get, accounts_list, coaching_get_development_plans, coaching_get_meeting, coaching_get_reviews, deals_generate_insights, deals_get, deals_get_coaching_scores, deals_get_contacts, deals_get_insights, deals_get_meddpicc, and deals_get_team_members.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to ASPR AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to ASPR AI in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.

_published_faq.name: Does ASPR AI MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: ASPR AI requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
ASPR AI is developed by ASPR AI. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
